About Us

Transforming Nigerian produce into value-added food

Mosi Agro Industries Limited is a Nigerian agribusiness and agro-processing company committed to transforming locally sourced agricultural produce into high-quality, nutritious food products for local and international markets.

Through innovation, sustainable agricultural practices and quality-driven processing, we focus on agricultural production, food processing, natural food products, packaging and export of Nigerian agricultural commodities.

We believe agriculture can

  • Improve lives
  • Create employment
  • Strengthen food security
  • Drive economic growth

Our vision

To become a leading African agribusiness brand recognised for quality, innovation and excellence in agricultural processing and exports.

Our philosophy

Growing Nature. Creating Value. Improving Lives.

Our Team & Certifications

Leadership

Kelvin Olugbami

Chairman & Founder

Kelvin is a Natural Lifestyle and Wellness Coach and entrepreneur, passionate about healthy living, natural nutrition, sustainable agriculture and the development of value-added African food products.

He advocates nature-based solutions for healthier lifestyles while creating opportunities in agriculture, food processing and entrepreneurship, and aims to inspire healthier communities and contribute to Africa’s economic growth.

Natural Living. Healthy People. Sustainable Growth.

Abimbola Blessing Sandra

Managing Partner & Managing Director

Abimbola is a professional Mental Health and Wellness Nurse, passionate about mental health, holistic wellness and improving quality of life through compassionate care and natural nutrition.

She combines healthcare experience with business leadership to drive the company’s vision, formulate and promote wellness-focused products and advance sustainable growth in agro-processing.
